items.title: Nature Journaling Workshop
items.summary: Join us for a guided walk and nature journaling workshop on the Kenwood Estate . Nature journaling is a method of recording and collecting your observations in a variety of ways - note making, sketching, writing or whatever method works best for you. Nature journaling can enrich your experience of the natural world, deepen your relationship with the local environment and help develop your identification skills. The £10 donation covers materials and our session leader’s time, but do let us know if that is unaffordable. FREE for Heath Hands members and for children under 18. You can also bring your own notebooks or pens if you wish. Also, feel free to bring your phones to take photos to draw from and try out some helpful apps. We'll share how technology can be used to bolster a nature journaling practice. All welcome. You do not need to be an artist or a naturalist to enjoy this workshop! Anyone under 18 should be accompanied by a responsible adult. We will be meeting on the Kenwood Estate - we’ll share the exact meeting point once you’ve booked. Please note, this event will be held mostly outside. If the weather is bad we may have to reschedule, but we will still go ahead if there’s a bit of rain! Our workshop leader Shilpa Agashe has also produced a Nature Journaling Workbook to use on your own adventures, which can be purchased via our webshop here . Find out more about Shilpa’s work here , or visit her website: shilpaagashe.com Book here

You can: pick up a free map or nature sheet find out about upcoming events and activities ask questions of our friendly team buy Hampstead Heath-related goodies (e.g. books, cards, bags)

items.title: Litter pick
items.summary: Join us for a Saturday afternoon litter pick. All welcome and all equipment provided. Meet at 12pm at the Heath Info Hut (the former Tennis Bookings Hut), Hampstead Heath, near the Parliament Hill tennis courts - no need to book, although you can let us know that you’re planning to come along so that we know roughly how many to expect.

items.title: Wild about Hampstead Heath
items.summary: Come and find out about nature on our green spaces with our volunteer wildlife interpreters. All welcome, drop in anytime between 1-3pm, no need to book. Look out for the big Wild About Hampstead Heath bike, in the Parliament Hill area.

items.title: Hedgeplanting with Hampstead Heath Eco Club
items.summary: Join us for the second event of our new Youth programme: Hampstead Heath Eco Club . This time, we’ll be planting new hedges around the Parliament Hill area! Join us to find out about the importance of hedges for wildlife and biodiversity and make a real difference by planting your own little trees on Hampstead Heath! This is a youth event , open to children age 10-17 only . Booking is required (click the button below), and we’ll send joining instructions prior to the event. We’ll meet in the Parliament Hill area - further details provided on booking. Book here

items.title: Hampstead Heath Photo Exhibition
items.summary: Join us at The Kenwood Dairy for an exhibition of this year’s top Hampstead Heath photo competition entries. The exhibition will include spectacular photographs of Hampstead Heath, including this year’s winning entry, a beautiful image by Joe Hayman, and the winning under 18s entry, a great shot by Milo Dawes, aged 13. No need to book, stop by between 10am-3pm from the 26th-28th of November. Teas and coffees to warm up also available for a donation, and there’ll be an opportunity to buy the Hampstead Heath Calendar as well as other Heath-related goodies. Milo Dawes - under 18s winner Joe Hayman - adult category winner

items.title: Queen’s Park Trees and Ecology walk
items.summary: Join us for a guided walk of Queen’s Park, looking at trees and their ecological value. The walk will meet outside the Queen’s Park Cafe - further instructions to be provided on booking. All welcome, including children of any age - but anyone under 18 should be accompanied by a responsible adult. The walk is free (donations welcome) but booking is essential. Book here

items.title: Gardening Volunteering
items.summary: Join our open volunteering sessions! We’ll be gardening and taking part in light conservation tasks around the Hive area. items.title: Wreath Making - Kenwood
items.summary: Join us for a workshop on Hampstead Heath to make your own festive wreath from natural materials. This workshop will take place on the Kenwood Estate. Once you’ve booked on (below) we will send you joining details for the workshop, including a detailed meeting point. There is a £25 donation, click below to book your space, to cover our costs for this workshop, which includes: All the materials you will need; Instructions from our friendly team; Hot drinks, Mince pies and other treats and Please note that our wreath-making workshops are outdoors - shelter will be provided in the event of rain, but do dress for the weather! Cancellations: if you can no longer attend, please let us know at least 72H before the event so that we can offer your space to someone else. We will not be able to issue refunds nearer to the workshop date. Are you interested in joining more events?
